steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on its Responses tab.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Ensure post-expiry surrogate bidding is disabled for the prepared closed RFQ.
Apply the required buyer bid-edit configuration.
Capture the unchanged response count before opening Rejected Bids.
Verify the first bid vendor before the window interaction.
Verify the first bid price before the window interaction.
Verify the second bid vendor in the prepared state before the window interaction.
Verify the second bid price before the window interaction.
Open the Rejected Bids window from the RFQ stage settings.
Confirm the Rejected Bids window opened.
Close the Rejected Bids window as required by the case.
Confirm the Rejected Bids window is closed.
Verify that the response count is unchanged after closing the window.
Verify the first bid vendor remains unchanged.
Verify the first bid price remains unchanged.
Verify the second bid vendor remains unchanged.
Verify the second bid price remains unchanged.
